_doc: House pacing standard: every episode, made by any agent on any machine, runs at the same speed. Shared; do not edit per episode (series decision + CHANGELOG line). Enforced by script_lint.py (G2: word budget), voice.py/sv_gate G3 (measured voice), lint.mjs shots PC-01..03 (G5: cutting), deliver report (G7: length).

calibration._doc: measured 2026-11-16 on the three approved episodes

voice._speed_why: Hải Đăng is used at the engine's native speed (1.0x, about 4.5 words/s inside a line). Never time-stretch, speed up (atempo) or pitch-shift: pictures follow the voice.

episode._why: user: 'tầm 2,5 phút'. Words budget = 140-165 s x 4.33 words/s (voice incl. pauses).

shots._why: approved episodes cut every 2.2-2.8 s on average (21-27 shots/min); faster reads frantic for this deadpan narrator, slower lets a 2.5 min episode sag
